title: Noel Tata renews challenge to Chandrasekaran’s reappointment, questions Tata Sons board voting and conflict of interest
excerpt: Noel Tata has raised concerns about N Chandrasekaran's reappointment as executive chairman of Tata Sons. His objections relate to board procedures, including voting requirements and potential conflicts of interest. The board approved Chandrasekaran's position despite Noel Tata's requests for detailed meeting records. Additionally, he questioned the legitimacy of the meeting agenda and the absence of a selection committee.

title: Noel Tata disputes Tata Sons board minutes, says Chandrasekaran's reappointment should be deleted from official records.
excerpt: The minutes misrepresented his objections and omitted mention of two key conditions agreed by board members, Noel Tata wrote. However, Tata Sons did not make the changes requested, and made a statutory filing about the reappointment.

title: Rising concentration in AI stocks poses a risk: Kunal Kapoor, Morningstar CEO
excerpt: Kunal Kapoor, the CEO of Morningstar, voiced unease about the dangers of focusing investments heavily on AI stocks during his Mumbai trip. He stressed that lofty expectations might not always reflect in company profits, potentially leading to disappointing market outcomes. While praising India's compelling growth story, he remarked that its investment valuations do not stand up favorably against those in emerging markets.

ai.why: ఇది ఇన్వెస్టర్లకు AI రంగంలోని ఓవర్‌వాల్యుయేషన్‌ను గుర్తించి, పోర్ట్‌ఫోలియో డైవర్సిఫికేషన్‌పై దృష్టి పెట్టాలని సూచిస్తుంది.

ai.market_impact_te: AI మరియు IT సెక్టార్ షేర్లపై కొంత ప్రాసెషన్ వచ్చే అవకాశం ఉంది, ముఖ్యంగా వాల్యుయేషన్లు ఎక్కువగా ఉన్న కంపెనీలపై.
ai.impact_reason_te: వాల్యుయేషన్లు ఎక్కువగా ఉన్నప్పుడు, కంపెనీల లాభాలు ఆ అంచనాలను సంతృప్తిపరచకపోతే షేర్ ధరలు త్వరగా పడిపోతాయి. ఇది సెంటిమెంట్‌ను ప్రభావితం చేసి, పెట్టుబడిదారులు డిస్‌రిస్క్ చేయడానికి దారితీస్తుంది.

title: Retail investors return to equities with Rs 10,572 crore buying in September
excerpt: After two months of silence, September marked the return of retail investors to the secondary market, as they invested ₹10,572 crore in equities. This shift occurred after a significant market dip linked to escalating oil prices. In contrast, foreign portfolio investors continued their exit strategy. Additionally, the primary market thrived with ₹5,650 crore in shares bought by retail investors, emphasizing that upcoming market conditions will shape their future involvement.

title: Indian markets rebound, but rising oil prices keep investors cautious
excerpt: On Monday, Indian equity markets staged a comeback following four days of losses, with both the BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty seeing notable gains as investors sought to take advantage of cheaper stock prices. However, analysts warn that this recovery is precarious, influenced by global geopolitical issues and high crude oil prices.

ai.title_te: భారత మార్కెట్లు పునరుద్ధరణ, కానీ పెరిగిన నూనె ధరలు ఇన్వెస్టర్లను జాగ్రత్తగా ఉంచుతున్నాయి

title: Jio IPO delivers smaller payday for bankers than other mega offerings
excerpt: In a landmark move, Jio Platforms, supported by Mukesh Ambani, successfully secured ₹30,213 crore, marking the largest IPO in India’s history. Investment bankers were rewarded with ₹196 crore in fees, translating to only 0.65% of the total amount raised. In contrast, Hyundai Motor India achieved ₹27,859 crore while paying out a heftier ₹493 crore in fees, which amount to 1.77%.

ai.title_te: Jio IPO: బ్యాంకర్లకు తక్కువ ఫీజులు, భారతీయ చరిత్రలో అతిపెద్ద IPO

ai.why: Jio IPO యొక్క విజయం భారతీయ మార్కెట్ యొక్క లిక్విడిటీ మరియు రిటైల్ ఇన్వెస్టర్ల ఆసక్తిని సూచిస్తుంది. తక్కువ ఫీజు నిష్పత్తి కంపెనీ యొక్క ఖర్చులను తగ్గించి, భవిష్యత్ లాభదాయకతను మెరుగుపరుస్తుంది.
ai.why_it_matters_te: Jio IPO యొక్క విజయం భారతీయ మార్కెట్ యొక్క లిక్విడిటీ మరియు రిటైల్ ఇన్వెస్టర్ల ఆసక్తిని సూచిస్తుంది. తక్కువ ఫీజు నిష్పత్తి కంపెనీ యొక్క ఖర్చులను తగ్గించి, భవిష్యత్ లాభదాయకతను మెరుగుపరుస్తుంది.

title: Aerospace stock Aequs plunges 19% after Q2 results. Why are investors worried?

Forex traders said the Indian currency showed some recovery on likely intervention by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), but failed to withstand pressure from foreign fund outflows amid subdued domestic equity market sentiment.

title: Jio Platforms shares to list on BSE, NSE tomorrow; GMP signals 22% premium
excerpt: Jio Platforms shares are set to list on the BSE and NSE on October 28, with the IPO commanding a grey market premium of around 22%. The Rs 30,213-crore issue was subscribed 22.19 times, led by strong institutional demand. Investors will watch the listing amid Jio’s growth ambitions and financial performance.

ai.title_te: జియో ప్లాట్‌ఫార్మ్స్ స్టాక్ బీఎస్‌ఈ, ఎన్ఎస్‌ఈలో లిస్టింగ్, 22% GMP
ai.summary: జియో ప్లాట్‌ఫార్మ్స్ 28 అక్టోబర్ బీఎస్‌ఈ, ఎన్ఎస్‌ఈలో లిస్టింగ్ అవుతుంది. IPOకి 22% గ్రే మార్కెట్ ప్రీమియం, 30,213 కోట్లు రూపాయల ఇష్యూ 22.19 రెట్లు సబ్‌స్క్రైబ్ అయింది, సంస్థాపక డిమాండ్ బలంగా ఉంది.
ai.summary_te: జియో ప్లాట్‌ఫార్మ్స్ 28 అక్టోబర్ బీఎస్‌ఈ, ఎన్ఎస్‌ఈలో లిస్టింగ్ అవుతుంది. IPOకి 22% గ్రే మార్కెట్ ప్రీమియం, 30,213 కోట్లు రూపాయల ఇష్యూ 22.19 రెట్లు సబ్‌స్క్రైబ్ అయింది, సంస్థాపక డిమాండ్ బలంగా ఉంది.
ai.why: జియో ప్లాట్‌ఫార్మ్స్ లిస్టింగ్ మార్కెట్‌లో పెద్ద IPOగా, టెలికాం, డిజిటల్ సేవల రంగంలో పెట్టుబడిదారుల ఆసక్తిని పెంచుతుంది.
ai.why_it_matters_te: జియో ప్లాట్‌ఫార్మ్స్ లిస్టింగ్ మార్కెట్‌లో పెద్ద IPOగా, టెలికాం, డిజిటల్ సేవల రంగంలో పెట్టుబడిదారుల ఆసక్తిని పెంచుతుంది.

ai.impact_reason_te: విస్తృత IPO సబ్‌స్క్రిప్షన్ ద్వారా సంస్థకు మూలధన సేకరణ, పెట్టుబడిదారుల విశ్వాసం పెరుగుతుంది, ఇది స్టాక్ ధరలపై బుల్లిష్ ఒత్తిడిని సృష్టిస్తుంది.

title: Cipla Q2 Results: Profit falls 35% YoY to Rs 878 crore; revenue slips 2%
excerpt: Cipla reported a 35% drop in consolidated net profit for Q2FY27, which stood at Rs 878 crore. The company also experienced a 2.4% year-on-year decline in revenue from operations, totaling Rs 7,404 crore. Additionally, a significant 26.7% decrease in EBITDA resulted in a lower margin of 18.7%. Nonetheless, Cipla's One India division demonstrated growth across various segments, while the company aims to enhance productivity and innovate its product offerings.

ai.title_te: సిప్లా Q2 ఫలితాలు: లాభం 35% తగ్గి, ఆదాయం 2% తగ్గింది
ai.summary: సిప్లా Q2FY27 కన్సాలిడేటె నెట్ లాభం Rs 878 కోట్లు, గత సంవత్సరం 대비 35% తగ్గింది. ఆదాయం Rs 7,404 కోట్లు, 2.4% తగ్గింది. EBITDA 26.7% పడిపోయి, మార్జిన్ 18.7%కి దిగింది.

ai.market_impact_te: CIPLA స్టాక్‌లో విక్రయ ఒత్తిడి, ఫార్మా ఇండెక్స్‌లో చిన్న‑మధ్య‑కాల తగ్గుదల.

title: Gold, Silver ETFs sink up to 53% from 52-week highs; Silver at 11-month low
excerpt: According to NSE data, Silver ETFs have crashed up to 53% from their respective 52-week highs hit in January 2026, while Gold ETFs have declined up to 26% in the same period.

title: Indian lenders defer dollar debt sale plan as rates turn expensive
excerpt: Amidst rising US Treasury yields and a depreciating rupee, multiple Indian banks, such as Canara Bank, PNB, and Bank of India, are delaying their dollar debt initiatives. The looming expiration of the Reserve Bank of India’s hedging facility in December adds further pressure to these institutions. Nevertheless, there remains a glimmer of optimism among certain banks regarding potential future dollar bond sales as market conditions evolve.

title: Maruti Suzuki Q2 Results: Profit falls 26% YoY to Rs 2,466 crore, but revenue rises 26%

title: Britain issues costliest 5-year debt since 2008 before budget
excerpt: Britain conducted a sale of £4.5 billion worth of 5-year debt at a yield of 5.036%. This yield reflects the highest rate seen since the year 2008, indicating market pressures on the government. Investors showed robust interest, bidding 3.51 times the amount available during the gilt auction. Experts anticipate only a modest rise in debt issuance as projected figures indicate increased financing requirements.

title: Coca-Cola raises profit forecast as premium drinks, sodas hold strong
excerpt: Coca-Cola has lifted its annual profit forecast, driven by robust demand for a range of beverages, particularly zero-sugar options. The company now anticipates earnings per share growth of at least 9% by 2026. Their third-quarter revenue soared to $13.38 billion, exceeding analysts' expectations, while Coca-Cola's strong showing stands in sharp contrast to PepsiCo's recent downgrades and cost-cutting plans. Following these promising results, Coca-Cola shares rose nearly 1% in premarket trading.

title: India to remain top of the Asian pie for Advent
excerpt: Advent International has successfully raised $30 billion for its global buyout and mid-market funds. The firm plans to invest significantly in India, expecting healthy GDP growth in the country. With recent investments including Yatharth Hospitals and Aditya Birla Housing Finance, Advent remains confident in the Indian market potential. The new fund is set to target various sectors including healthcare, technology services, and industrials.

ai.title_te: Advent International, $30 బిలియన్ ఫండ్‌తో భారత మార్కెట్‌లో భారీ పెట్టుబడి

title: JLR bets on local assembly, EVs to defend India luxury car ranking
excerpt: The Tata Motors-owned carmaker expects local assembly to cut Defender SUV prices by up to 20% as it seeks to narrow the gap with Mercedes-Benz and BMW in India’s luxury car market.

title: Advent International raises $30 billion, including nearly $27 billion for its 11th flagship buyout fund
excerpt: Advent International has successfully raised $30 billion, with $27 billion designated for its latest flagship fund. The new mid-market strategy has received over $3 billion in commitments since its launch in March. title: United Breweries Q2 Results: Profit jumps nearly 3 times to Rs 134 crore on volume growth, premiumisation
excerpt: United Breweries Ltd experienced a nearly three-fold increase in net profit for the September quarter. The company's revenue from operations rose by 23.7 percent year-on-year, reflecting strong market performance. Premium volumes notably surged, particularly for Heineken Silver and Kingfisher Ultra, enhancing UBL's premium offerings. Total expenses also increased, but operating efficiency and cost control contributed to profitability expansion. UBL remains optimistic about future growth opportunities in the Indian beer market.

title: Trading starts on LME's first contract from Shanghai exchange collaboration

title: Sebi extends compliance deadline for debenture trustees till April 2027
excerpt:
Markets regulator Sebi on Tuesday extended the deadline by six months, till April 27, 2027, for debenture trustees to comply with requirements governing activities that fall outside its regulatory purview.
Under Regulation 9C of the Sebi (Debenture Trustees) Regulations, 1993, a debenture trustee holding a valid certificate of registration is required to transfer activities not regulated by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) to separate business units within a prescribed timeline.
The provision was introduced through amendments notified on October 27, 2025, to provide clarity on the scope of activities permitted for debenture trustees.
